description:
Windsor.ai YouTube connects your YouTube Analytics data to your AI assistant, so you can explore channel and video performance in plain English. Discover connected channels, inspect valid fields and options, and query views, watch time, average view duration, subscribers gained, likes, comments, and traffic sources over any date range or by day, week, and month.

Common workflows:
- See your top videos by views and watch time last month
- Track subscriber growth over the last 90 days
- Break down views by traffic source

It provides read-only analytics and does not run write actions or change any YouTube settings. Free plan available, no credit card required.

Windsor.ai is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the platforms it connects to.

defaultPrompt: Which videos drove the most watch time on my YouTube channel in the last 30 days?
How many subscribers did my channel gain and lose last month?
Compare Shorts vs. regular videos by average view percentage this quarter.
